content.short: Exodus is a multi-chain self-custody wallet for desktop and mobile with built-in exchange.
content.description: Exodus is a self-custody wallet spanning desktop, mobile and browser, in operation since 2015 and supporting thousands of assets. In-wallet swaps start at rates around 0.5 percent, and buying and selling happen without leaving the app. Staking for multiple assets is available in one place, alongside a spend card with cashback and everyday payments integrated into the wallet itself. An XO Suite offers the same self-custody stack to businesses, and support engineers are available around the clock.
content.meta: Exodus is a multi-chain self-custody wallet for desktop and mobile with built-in swapping and staking.
